viewing_check: Check the disc stack and bowl are complete and matching serial numbers, the maker plate/decal (Alfa-Laval vs Alfa Felix, model number), crank turns freely, no cracks in the bowl or tank, and whether any original paint/transfer survives. Photograph the nameplate.
